name: Under a Witch's Curse
source:
A witch has kidnapped you and cursed you to eventually become a familiar! With the guide of Nimuel the fairy, you'll surely escape!

.. right? There's no way you're going to fall for a witch..

[From [url=https://kerocipher.itch.io/under-a-witchs-curse]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
女巫绑架了你并诅咒你最终成为魔宠！在仙女尼缪尔的指引下，你一定能逃脱！

.. 正确的？你不可能爱上女巫的。

[来自[url=https://kerocipher.itch.io/under-a-witchs-curse]itch.io[/url]]
